units.text: The Lord is high above all nations; His glory is above the heavens.

And the foreigners attached to the Lord, to serve Him and love the Lord’s name, to become His male and female slaves, and all those keeping My Sabbaths from profanation and holding fast to My covenant—

I will bring them into My holy mountain and make them rejoice in My house of prayer. Their whole burnt offerings and sacrifices will be acceptable on My altar, for My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations,”
said the Lord who gathers Israel’s scattered people, “for I will gather a gathering to him.”
My sword became drunk in heaven. Behold, it will descend upon Idumea and upon the people of destruction, with judgment.
The Lord’s sword was filled with blood, thickened with lambs’ fat and the fat of male goats and rams, for the Lord has a sacrifice in Bosor and a great slaughter in Idumea.
The stout ones will fall with them, and rams and bulls; the earth will become drunk with blood and be filled with their fat.
For it is the Lord’s day of judgment and a year of repayment for Zion’s judgment.

Every firstborn male that is born among your cattle and among your sheep you shall sanctify unto the Lord your God. You shall do no work with your firstborn calf, neither shall you shear the firstborn of your sheep.
You shall eat it before the Lord, year by year, in the place which the Lord your God shall choose, you and your house.
And if there is a blemish in it, lameness or blindness or any grievous blemish, you shall not sacrifice it unto the Lord your God.
You shall eat it within your cities; the unclean among you and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle or the deer.
Only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it upon the earth as water.
One who sacrifices from unjust gain makes a blemished offering, and the gifts of the lawless bring no acceptance.
The Most High takes no pleasure in the offerings of the ungodly, nor does He atone for sins through a multitude of sacrifices.
The one who presents a sacrifice from the property of the poor is slaughtering a son before his father.
The bread of the needy is the life of the poor; the one who deprives them of it is a man of blood.
The one who takes away a livelihood murders his neighbor, and the one who withholds a hired worker’s wage sheds blood.
One builds and another tears down; what have they gained beyond toil?
One prays and another curses; whose voice will the Master hear?
Someone washes after contact with a corpse and then touches it again; what has he gained by his washing?
So is a person who fasts over his sins and goes again to do the same things. Who will hear his prayer, and what has he gained by humbling himself?
The Levitical priests, the whole tribe of Levi, shall have neither portion nor inheritance with Israel. The offerings of the Lord are their inheritance; they shall eat them.
And they shall have no inheritance among their brethren; the Lord Himself is his inheritance, as He spoke unto him.
And this shall be the priests’ due from the people, from them that sacrifice a sacrifice, whether a calf or a sheep: they shall give unto the priest the foreleg, and the cheeks, and the stomach.
And you shall give unto him the firstfruits of your grain, and of your wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.
For the Lord your God has chosen him out of all your tribes, to stand before the Lord your God, to minister and to bless in His name, he and his sons among the sons of Israel.
But if you do not obey Me and do not do these ordinances of Mine,
but disobey them, and your soul is indignant at My judgments, so that you do not do all My commandments, so as to dissolve My covenant,
then I will do this to you: I will bring distress upon you, scab and jaundice that waste your eyes and melt away your life. You shall sow your seeds in vain, and your adversaries shall eat them.
And I will set My face against you, and you shall fall before your enemies. Those who hate you shall pursue you, and you shall flee when no one pursues you.

And it shall be, if you do not hearken unto the voice of the Lord your God, to keep and do all His commandments which I command you this day, that all these curses shall come upon you, and overtake you.
Cursed are you in the city, and cursed are you in the field.
Cursed are your storehouses and your reserves.
Cursed are the offspring of your womb, and the produce of your land, the herds of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep.
Cursed are you when you go out, and cursed are you when you come in.

The Lord send upon you want, and famine, and wasting, in all that you put your hand unto, whatsoever you do, until He destroys you, and causes you to perish speedily, because of your evil practices, because you have forsaken Me.
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
Phinehas son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, has stopped My wrath against the sons of Israel by being zealous with My zeal among them, and I did not consume the sons of Israel in My zeal.
Therefore say: Behold, I give him a covenant of peace.
And it shall be for him and his seed after him an everlasting covenant of priesthood, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the sons of Israel.
And unto Levi he said, Give unto Levi his manifestations, and his truth unto the holy man, whom they tested in a trial, and reviled at the water of dispute;
who says unto his father and his mother, I have not seen you; and he did not acknowledge his brethren, and disowned his sons. He kept Thine oracles, and preserved Thy covenant.
They shall declare Thine ordinances unto Jacob, and Thy law unto Israel; they shall lay incense in Thy wrath, continually upon Thine altar.
Bless, O Lord, his strength, and accept the works of his hands; break the loin of the enemies who rise against him, and let not them that hate him arise.
And the Lord spoke unto Aaron, saying:

You shall drink no wine or strong drink, you and your sons with you, when you enter the Tent of Testimony, or when you approach the altar, so that you do not die: an everlasting statute throughout your generations,
to distinguish between the holy and the profane, and between the unclean and the clean.
And you shall instruct the sons of Israel in all the statutes which the Lord spoke unto them by the hand of Moses.

And if a matter in judgment is too hard for you, between blood and blood, and between judgment and judgment, and between injury and injury, and between dispute and dispute, matters of judgment within your cities, you shall arise and go up unto the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there.
And you shall come unto the Levitical priests, and unto the judge who shall be in those days; and they shall inquire, and declare unto you the judgment.

And you shall do according to the matter which they declare unto you from the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there; and you shall take diligent heed to do according to all that is laid down for you as law.
You shall do according to the law and according to the judgment which they tell you; you shall not turn aside from the word which they declare unto you, to the right hand or to the left.

And the man who acts presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest who stands to minister in the name of the Lord your God, or unto the judge who shall be in those days, that man shall die; and you shall remove the evil one from Israel.
And all the people shall hear and fear, and shall act ungodly no more.

My people were likened to one without knowledge. Because you thrust away recognition, I too will thrust you away from serving Me as priest. You forgot your God’s law, and I too will forget your children.
According to their multitude, so they sinned against Me; I will turn their glory into dishonor.
They will eat My people’s sins and take their souls amid their injustices.
It will be as with the people, so with the priest; I will exact punishment upon him for his ways and repay him for his schemes.
You shall appoint judges and recording officers for yourself in all your cities which the Lord your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
They shall not pervert judgment, neither shall they show partiality, nor take a bribe; for bribes blind the eyes of the wise, and overthrow the words of the righteous.
You shall pursue justly that which is just, that you may live, and enter and inherit the land which the Lord your God gives you.
one body and one Spirit, just as you were also called in one hope of your calling;
one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
Do you thus repay the Lord, O foolish people and unwise? Is not He Himself your Father, who acquired you, and made you, and created you?
